title: OpenAI Teams Up with ModRetro to Release a Dedicated Plugin for Codex: Create Retro Game Boy Games with Just Your Voice

content_html:
At today's 2026 Developer Day event, OpenAI introduced an eye-catching new cross-industry collaboration. The official announced a partnership with the retro handheld console manufacturer ModRetro, officially integrating its AI intelligent agent coding tool Codex into the retro handheld Chromatic, and launched a dedicated plugin called Game Studio.

In terms of core functions and actual gameplay, Game Studio completely breaks down the professional barriers of traditional game development. When using it in daily life, users only need to describe their game ideas and requirements in detail through natural language, and the underlying Codex will take full charge of generating the corresponding program code. In addition, the plugin directly integrates the Chromatic emulator inside, allowing developers to perform real-time game testing on their computers, and then一键 stream the game to a real device once it is confirmed to be error-free.
